name: Competitive Analysis
description: Options or competitors scored side by side, with positioning and talk tracks.
briefPlaceholder: Which options or competitors should be compared, and on what criteria? Include anything you already know about them...
promptScaffold:
This job produces a COMPETITIVE ANALYSIS exhibit.
- Compare the options or competitors named in the brief side by side: a comparison matrix of criteria vs. options, with scores and short justifications per cell.
- Support weighted scoring: let the user adjust criterion weights and watch rankings update live.
- Include a positioning summary per option (strengths, weaknesses, best-fit customer) and suggested talk tracks or counterpoints.
- Ground every claim in the brief or well-known public information; flag uncertain claims explicitly rather than fabricating specifics.

options.label: Document
options.prompt: The source material is this local document: {value} — read it.

options.label: Competitor website
options.prompt: A competitor website to analyze: {value} — fetch it (e.g., with curl) and review its content.
